# Advisories that govulncheck reports as reachable and that we have decided not
# to block the build on. Anything reachable and not listed here fails CI, so a
# new advisory -- the case this file exists for -- stops a pull request until
# somebody looks at it.
#
# This file applies to both scans: xiond (the chain) and e2e_tests. Exceptions
# whose rationale is that the code only runs in the e2e harness belong in
# govulncheck-allowlist-e2e.txt instead, which only the e2e scan reads, so a
# dependency change that makes one of them reachable from xiond still fails.
#
# Every entry needs a reason. An entry with a fix available is debt, not a
# decision: say where it is tracked so the line can be deleted rather than
# inherited. Regenerate with `make vulncheck-report` after any dependency or
# toolchain change, and delete what no longer appears.
#
# Baseline retaken on release/v31 under the go1.25.14 toolchain that go.mod
# pins. Standard library findings move whenever that directive does, so this
# file has to be regenerated alongside any toolchain bump.

# --- No fix available ------------------------------------------------------
# Upstream has published no fixed version. Listed so the exposure is a recorded
# decision rather than a silent one.
GO-2023-1821  # cosmos-sdk x/crisis does not halt the chain. Informational
              # Cosmos advisory against a module we run with default params.
GO-2023-1881  # cosmos-sdk x/crisis does not charge ConstantFee. As above.
GO-2024-2584  # cosmos-sdk slashing evasion. No fixed version published.
GO-2026-4513  # shamaton/msgpack v2.4.1 denial of service. Transitive, reached
              # only through decoding paths that do not take untrusted input.
GO-2026-4740  # shamaton/msgpack v2.4.1 denial of service. As above.
GO-2026-5932  # golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained by design.
